item.coloph: gdams pa rin po che gser gyis (gyi) sgron ma 'di/ skal bzang dgongs pa'i yang bcud/ 'od ldan 'bar ma'i yang snying*/ nyi ma 'od ldan gyi snying gtam/ srid rgyal yum gyi dngos grub/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs/ skal ldan rnams kyi nor bu/ 'khor 'das dwangs snyig phyed pa'i rlung po/ dad ldan yar 'dzeg rnams kyi lam mkhan/ zad med gter chen bton pa'i lde mig dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i rin chen 'di/ 'gro ba'i don du yig ge ris su bkod//
